title: [ingest] Bench cost-weighting: cache_read x0.1, output x5, cache_creation x1.25
summary: bench-report.js converts to input-token-equivalents using CACHE_READ_W=0.1, OUTPUT_W=5, CACHE_CREATION_W=1.25 (cache hits bill ~10% of fresh input; output is 5x). Raw GROSS/NET sums treat every token equally and so OVERSTATE cost. C (consult overhead) = costCache(ON) - costCache(OFF).
